intervention: Render future steps and evidence individually before the authentication declaration, then display the existing hypothesis authentication contract and comparison meaning from model fields. No prose-based role inference, new schema fields, extra review stage, or changed rubric.

promotion_criteria.focused_mismatches: Candidate identifies at least 4 of 6 mismatch trials and improves on baseline.
promotion_criteria.valid_cases: Candidate produces no revise identity verdict in the 10 valid-case trials.
promotion_criteria.recorded_context: Candidate identifies the identity inconsistency in at least 2 of 3 recorded-context trials, improving on baseline, with valid native output and consistent retain/revise decisions.
promotion_criteria.failure_policy: Do not promote the identity presentation if criteria are unmet. Preserve all failures; do not tune prompts or rerun failed trials until passing.

limitations: Small fixed fixture study; no significance or end-to-end adoption claim.
Recorded context is redacted and decoded; prior assistant conclusion and finalization handoff are excluded.
Recorded context replay uses the native role harness with the recorded evaluator system boundary and a production bound output model, without artifact tools or controller persistence.

Hypothesis empty-role semantics differ from unrestricted generic credential selection. Missing readiness does not alone invalidate a future proposal; the original catalog declares user only, so an admin role must not be invented.
